scope: Complete remaining-lifetime, area effect payload ownership, deferred callback storage/pool/vector/swap service bodies; main world tick expiry and scheduler execution are outside this module.

limitations: The full main spServerThink body, including when callbacks execute and effects are removed on expiry, remains outside this module.
Clock read21, free14, memcpy15, malloc16, operatorNewOrAbort20 and native length-error58 remain explicit shared dependencies.
Typed callback targets are retained table dispatch, allowing separately recovered virtual bodies to be used by the registry.
Synthetic inline callbacks and a destructor-induced replacement fixture are declared test substitutions; the actual Peas fixture uses the shipped factory/launch callbacks.
Tests are bounded evidence, not a proof for every arbitrary overlapping or corrupt memory arrangement.
The invalid-clock lifetime branch is statically recovered; ordinary retained readClock returns a valid clock, so that branch is not separately forced in the differential tests.

functions.name: remainingEffectLifetime
behavior: Allocate a16-byte original stack frame and invoke the original readClock service.
Return +Infinity for an untimed effect, -Infinity when a timed effect has no valid clock, otherwise f32(expiryF64-nowF64).
Restore stack only on normal return; a trap retains its active frame.

functions.name: releaseDeferredSlot
behavior: Move the slot pointer from its unique holder, zeroing the holder before callback destruction.
Destroy inline callbacks through vtable slot4 and external callbacks through slot5.
Append the40-byte slot address to the global free max-heap and sift upward with unsigned address comparisons.
Retain slot bytes after callback destruction; return the holder address.

functions.name: replaceAreaEffect
behavior: Store intensity as f32 and visit the intrusive tracked-target handle vector.
Replace an existing shared area payload in each target effect pointer vector; append when there was no previous payload; remove by replacing with last when clearing.
Preserve the original end write/length decrement if a malformed target vector lacks the previous payload.
Move incoming ownership into the area, destroy the previous payload through vtable slot1, then reread the installed payload after that callback.
When no payload remains, unlink every tracked handle, free the handle vector, and zero its count/capacity/items fields.

functions.name: growDeferredVector

hostDependencies.role: abort followed by unreachable for capacity overflow

behavior: Apply the original owned-vector capacity and overflow policy.
Allocate through operatorNewOrAbort; transfer the incoming unique slot pointer and zero its source.
Move old vector entries backward in original order; replace vector pointers; destroy moved-from entries through recovered func150; free the old allocation.

functions.name: swapDeferredCallbacks
behavior: Always allocate the original16-byte stack scratch frame, including self swaps.
Swap external/empty callbacks through pointer exchange.
Use exact typed vtable slot3 copy and slot4 inline destruction for inline/inline and inline/external swaps.
Reload callback pointers after callbacks before subsequent operations, preserving reentrant state and trap ordering.

functions.name: acquireDeferredSlot
behavior: Prefer the highest-address released40-byte slot from the global max-heap; preserve pop swaps, tie selection and sift writes.
Otherwise allocate sequentially from a4096-slot block using40-byte stride.
When full, allocate163840 bytes, grow the block pointer vector through malloc/memcpy/free, append the block, set used1 and then publish the new block count.
Return an existing/new slot without initializing its bytes.
